description: Use this when the user names a specific game and wants the full multiplayer picture: platforms, online and same-screen player counts, crossplay for every pair of its platforms, session length, whether one copy is enough for the group, and the link to its CoopGames page. Accepts the game name or slug. If the name is ambiguous or unknown it returns an error with up to 5 suggestions to retry with. For a single yes/no between two platforms, crossplay_check is lighter. Read-only.

name.description: Game name or slug, e.g. 'It Takes Two'

name: get_game
